title: pixelworld style pack, v1
$comment: Generated from packages/style/src/schema.ts and schemaDocs.ts by their test (pnpm vitest run packages/style -u); edit those, not this. docs/style-guide.md §18.
description: A pixelworld style pack: palette ramps, surfaces, roads, assets, night and atmosphere (docs/style-guide.md).

$schema.description: This schema, for editors: style-pack.v1.schema.json in packages/style/schema/ in the repository, or in node_modules/pixelworld/dist/ from npm.

extends.description: Another pack's id: this pack is merged over it. Objects merge key by key, anything else replaces, and null deletes the parent's key (docs/style-guide.md §18).

id.description: The pack's id: its directory under worlds/_styles/, and what a world's manifest names (`style`).

plugins.description: The generator plugins the assets need, by npm name (docs/plugins.md §9): a view loads them before its first bake.

shades.description: Shades per ramp: always 6 (0 the outline, 1–5 lighting).

background.description: Palette index 0: the background and empty pixels.

silhouette.description: Palette index 253: a hidden rover's dithered silhouette.

depthThreshold.description: A pixel gets its ramp's shade 0 when a neighbour is this much deeper (2.0: cliffs of 2 steps).

strength.description: How strongly occlusion darkens, in shades.

steepRockSlope.description: Micro-cell tops steeper than this rise over run are bare rock (D-036).

ramps.errorMessage: A pack holds at most 42 ramps: the palette is 256 indexed colours, index 0 the background, 6 shades a ramp from index 1, and 253 the silhouette, so 1 + 42 × 6 = 253 (docs/style-guide.md §2).
ramps.description: Palette ramps by name, in palette order: ramp k is palette indices 1 + 6k to 6 + 6k. At most 42.

additionalProperties.description: Bands from the highest down: a pixel takes the first band it is above.

strataSets.description: Rock strata by elevation, in sets a world's geology provinces choose between: 1 to 4 sets of 1 to 16 bands.

defaultStrata.description: The strata set for worlds and provinces without a mapping.

provinces.description: Geology province name → strata set name.

surfaces.description: Ground surface name (from the world's manifest) → how it is drawn. `none` is the fallback.

asphalt.description: The ramp roads are paved in.

rail.description: Rails in the street (M3.5); without it, none are drawn.

ramp.description: Dashed lane lines and median kerbs.

minPixels.description: The narrowest lane drawn, in pixels across: narrower lanes draw fewer, wider ones, and none below two.

dash.description: Dash and gap along a lane line, in lane widths: [dash > 0, gap ≥ 0]. Default [1, 2].

median.description: Medians between a divided road's carriageways: a strip this many lanes wide (0: none).

lanes.description: Lane lines and medians (M3.5), on worlds with lane counts.

halfWidth.description: Half-width in render units, for worlds without real widths (D-050).

centerLine.description: A one-pixel centre line in the marking ramp.

ramp.description: The class's own surface ramp; asphalt if absent.

lanes.description: Lane lines where the world counts lanes (`roads.lanes`).

additionalProperties.description: How a road class is drawn.

classes.description: Road class name (from the world's manifest) → how it is drawn.

roads.description: Roads, drawn as decals in the bake (docs/style-guide.md §4).

ramp.description: The ramp the path is drawn in.

stripes.description: Alternate with asphalt in pixel stripes (crosswalks).

additionalProperties.description: How a path class is drawn.

classes.description: Path class name → how it is drawn, at its real width (D-050).

generator.description: The generator that draws the group, by registered name: a built-in, or one from a plugin in `plugins`.

ramps.description: Role → ramp: the colours the generator asks for by role. `wall.gold` is a variant of `wall` (picked by seed).

additionalProperties.description: A number, or a list of them.

params.description: The generator's parameters by name; each generator documents its own.

additionalProperties.description: A semantic group's generator, role ramps and parameters (D-030).

assets.description: Semantic group → asset. The longest dotted prefix wins: "tree.conifer.ponderosa" falls back to "tree.conifer", then "tree".

heightStretch.description: Extra vertical stretch for buildings and landmarks (a level's manifest can override it).

variants.description: Variants generated per group for repeated objects (vegetation, rocks).

surfaces.description: Replaces surface styles when a world has objects (real buildings make the block pattern redundant).

group.description: The semantic group to scatter; the pack needs an asset for it.

additionalProperties.description: What to scatter on the surface.

scatter.description: Decorative scatter (M3, D-054): surface name → objects added per cell, on worlds that ask for it.

multiply.description: Per-channel (r, g, b) multiplier for ordinary ramps.

add.description: Per-channel (r, g, b) offset (0–255) added after multiplying.

emissive.description: Ramps that glow at night → their night colours (6 shades).

night.description: The night palette (D-035): ordinary ramps darken, emissive ones glow; switching needs no re-bake.

atmosphere.description: Atmosphere layers drawn over the baked world; they never change a bake (D-063).

pack.description: A pixelworld style pack: palette ramps, surfaces, roads, assets, night and atmosphere (docs/style-guide.md).

variant.description: A pack that extends another: every key is optional, and null deletes the parent's.

ramp.errorMessage: A ramp is 6 colours, from shade 0 (the outline, darkest) to 5 (the lightest).
ramp.description: 6 shades, darkest (0, the outline) to lightest (5); shadows lean cool, highlights warm (docs/style-guide.md §2).
The ramp its tops are drawn in, or "strata": the ramp of the strata band at the elevation.

density.description: How much of the surface the pattern covers (keep it low).

light.description: How micro-terrain tops are lit: by micro-tile ("tiles", the default: terraces read as steps) or by the slope over about a cell ("slope": a smoothed lawn reads as one slope).

surface.description: How a ground surface is drawn.

ramp.description: The fog's own colour: a ramp…

veil.description: Veil levels, thin to thick: how far each moves a colour toward the fog's (increasing, 0–1; 1 is the fog's colour).

ceilingMeters.description: The top of the fog, in metres of drawn terrain height.

fadeMeters.description: The fog thins to nothing over this many metres below its ceiling.

polygon.description: The outline as [lon, lat] points (WGS84); the last joins the first.

density.description: Coverage inside, 0–1: the share of pixels the fog takes over low ground.

edgeMeters.description: Width of the soft edge in metres, centred on the outline (0: a hard edge).

areas.description: Where the fog lies; where areas overlap, the densest wins.

speed.description: Wind speed in real metres per second.

toward.description: Compass bearing the fog moves toward, in degrees (90 = east).

sizeMeters.description: Size of a patch, in metres.

contrast.description: 0 = even fog, 1 = patches with clear gaps between them.

drift.description: Patches drifting with the wind; without it the fog is even and still.

levels.description: Coverage per scale level (manifest `level`): unlisted levels 1, 0 turns fog off.

night.description: By night; without it, no fog at night.
